originalTitle: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
summary: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
content:
On-duty flight crew and passengers managed to foil a pilot's apparent attempt to crash a FlyDubai flight, after reports emerged of a fight in the cockpit.

The incident on flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv happened when a co-pilot stabbed a pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who praised the victim's quick thinking. "Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door, and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker — preventing a catastrophic mid-air disaster. He saved the lives of 174 people, including Israeli citizens and other nationals," Netanyahu wrote in a post on X.

FZ1073 was diverted to the Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia, the airline said, after being successfully secured and diverted by flight crew.

FlyDubai in a statement said that an "altercation" occurred on the flight deck of the plane, but did not mention a stabbing.

However, the airline added that the underlying reasons and motives for the clash is currently unknown, urging all parties to refrain from speculation.

The injured pilot was identified by Netanyahu as Indian national Smit Machchhar. No details have been released on the identity of the attacker, except that he was being interrogated by Saudi authorities.

The Indian embassy in Riyadh said on X that Machchhar is in a hospital in Tabuk, and is reported to be in stable condition.

The Israeli Prime Minister also identified the passenger who broke into the cockpit as Yaniv Hayun, calling him a "hero" and adding he deserved "a global medal of honor."

Flight data from tracking site FlightRadar24 showed that the plane had experienced extreme altitude fluctuations before broadcasting a "general emergency" squawk code.

FZ1073 had dropped from over 14,000 feet in just 29 seconds, and FlightRadar24 also added that vertical speeds ranging from approximately -30,000 to +10,000 feet per minute were observed from the transponder data.

For context, vertical speeds during normal operations rarely exceed plus or minus 4,000 feet per minute, it added.
chineseTitle: 乘客和机组人员挫败副驾驶企图撞毁飞往以色列的 FlyDubai 航班
chineseSummary: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡表示，飞往以色列的 FlyDubai 航班上的一名飞行员刺伤了第二名飞行员。
chineseContent:
在有报道称驾驶舱内发生打斗事件后，值班机组人员和乘客设法挫败了一名飞行员试图撞毁迪拜航空航班的行为。

以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡表示，在从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的 FZ1073 航班上，一名副机长刺伤了一名飞行员，并称赞受害者思维敏捷。内塔尼亚胡在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“尽管被刺伤并受重伤，但他进行了反击、抵抗，打开了驾驶舱门，使乘客和机组人员制服了袭击者，避免了一场灾难性的空中灾难。他拯救了 174 人的生命，其中包括以色列公民和其他国民。”

该航空公司表示，在机组人员成功保护并改道后，FZ1073 被改道飞往沙特阿拉伯塔布克机场。

FlyDubai 在一份声明中表示，飞机驾驶舱内发生了“争吵”，但没有提及刺伤事件。

不过，该航空公司补充称，目前尚不清楚冲突的根本原因和动机，敦促各方不要猜测。

内塔尼亚胡确认受伤飞行员是印度国民斯密特·马赫恰尔。目前没有公布袭击者身份的详细信息，只是称他正在接受沙特当局的审讯。

印度驻利雅得大使馆10日表示，马赫恰哈尔目前在塔布克的一家医院接受治疗，据报道情况稳定。

以色列总理还确认闯入驾驶舱的乘客是亚尼夫·哈云（Yaniv Hayun），称他为“英雄”，并补充说他应该获得“全球荣誉勋章”。

跟踪网站 FlightRadar24 的飞行数据显示，这架飞机在广播“一般紧急情况”尖叫代码之前经历了极端的高度波动。

FZ1073 在短短 29 秒内从超过 14,000 英尺的高度下降，FlightRadar24 还补充说，从应答器数据中观察到垂直速度范围为每分钟约 -30,000 至 +10,000 英尺。

就上下文而言，正常操作期间的垂直速度很少超过每分钟正负 4,000 英尺，它补充道。
